Manager.Name: Transitions
Manager.Label: Open Transitions
Manager.Hint: Bind transitions to scenes, scene pairs and stairways, and set the world default.

AskOnActivate.Name: Ask when activating a scene
AskOnActivate.Hint: Activating a scene opens a dialog to pick the transition, with the bound one picked. Hold Shift while clicking Activate to skip it. Off: the bound transition is used.

Enabled.Name: Play scene transitions
Enabled.Hint: Turn off to switch scenes without transitions on this computer only.

GmView.Name: Transitions when I only view a scene (GM)
GmView.Hint: Play bound transitions when you, as GM, view a scene without activating it. Activating, stairways and previews always play.
